title: TIME JUMP: Saturday 09:00 CAT, Nhamissa Distribution Line Breaks

fields.scenarioTitle: Wet Stock — Cyclone Response, Coordination & Pipeline Integrity
fields.narration: The clock moves forward one day. It is now 09:00 Central Africa Time on Saturday 13 February 2027, at the HRI country office in Beira. Here is what happened on Friday. The Emergency Coordinator landed at 11:45 and is now in the office. The three Buzi staff, Celso, Abílio and Graça, came back to Beira on UNHAS rotation 2 at 12:50. Abílio's hand was dressed at the office. Overnight the Emergency Relief Coordinator approved cluster activation for Sofala and Zambezia. HRI's 3W went to the cluster information managers at 16:52, and Flash update no. 1 went out at 19:00 with the usable stock from Recount 1. Gap list v3, issued at 07:30 this morning, shows the lines HRI accepted in writing last night. HRI is named as owner, and the coverage date is 07:30 Sunday. HRI asked INGD for the duty waiver letter for container MSKU 448210-3 at 16:00 on Friday. It has not arrived, and demurrage starts on Monday. The EN6 crossing at Dondo is still cut. The sky is clear and it is 31 degrees. Mains power is still off, and 1,200 litres of diesel were delivered to the office generator last night. At 08:00 this morning HRI opened a distribution of hygiene kits and jerrycans for 600 households at the Nhamissa displacement site, where about 6,800 people are staying. At 08:40 the distribution line broke. Several hundred people pushed against the fence at the distribution point. The HRI team pulled back behind the site management tent. All 64 staff are located. Eleven HRI staff are at Nhamissa now, and nine of them are national staff.
worldState: Clock: 09:00 CAT, Saturday 13 February 2027. Friday is closed. Any decision not taken on Friday was not taken.
The Emergency Coordinator is in Beira and has been in post since Friday afternoon.
The three Buzi staff are back in Beira. The driver's hand is dressed and he is not working today. The HRI vehicle is still at the Buzi town school on high ground.
Cluster activation for Sofala and Zambezia is approved: WASH, health, shelter, food security, protection and logistics.
HRI's 3W was submitted at 16:52 Friday, eight minutes before the 17:00 cut-off. Only activities in that 3W can go into the US$ 96 million flash appeal.

Flash update no. 1 (19:00 Friday) used Recount 1 usable stock: 2,400 shelter kits; 2,260 jerrycans; 3,180 hygiene kits; 10 portable water treatment units, plus 2 untested; water tablets for 20,000 people for 60 days.

Gap list v3 (07:30 Saturday) names HRI as owner of the lines it accepted in writing on Friday night. Coverage date: 07:30 Sunday 14 February. A line counts as covered only after the first service has happened and the cluster has verified it.
Container MSKU 448210-3 (6,000 tarpaulins): the INGD waiver letter was requested at 16:00 Friday and has not arrived. Demurrage starts Monday.
The EN6 crossing at Dondo is still cut. Buzi can be reached only by air or boat through the Logistics Cluster.
Weather: clear, 31 °C. Mains power is off. The office generator was refuelled with 1,200 L of diesel overnight.

Nhamissa displacement site, about 6,800 people: the hygiene kit and jerrycan distribution for 600 households opened at 08:00. At 08:40 the line broke and several hundred people pushed against the fence. The HRI team is behind the site management tent.
Roll call board: 64 of 64 located. 11 HRI staff are at Nhamissa (9 national, 2 international). The rest are in Beira and Dondo.
fields.facilitatorNote: Players must now play the Phase 3 commitments they actually made in writing. If they took G-W-01 Buzi or G-S-02 Nhamatanda without the stock, staff or access, hold them to the 07:30 Sunday coverage date. Do not rescue them. The Nhamissa surge opens Phase 4. Watch whether the SFP and CD treat it as a new threat to staff and decide what it means for the 9 national staff, not only the 2 internationals, and whether anyone asks what set off the push before the distribution resumes.

instructorNote: This card moves everyone to Saturday and makes players live with the gap-list lines and 3W entries they committed to on Friday. Watch whether the SFP and CD quickly treat the Nhamissa crowd surge as a new threat signal under the HMSSSP, with decisions that cover the national staff on site, before anyone presses on with distribution.

citations.documentTitle: SOP-COORD-01: Humanitarian Country Team, Clusters, 3W and the Gap List
citations.headingPath: SOP-COORD-01: Humanitarian Count… › 6. The gap list
citations.quote: A cluster keeps a list of gaps: a sector and an area where need is not matched by response (for example, "WASH in Buzi district, no partner"). A gap has: a description, the area, the cluster, the time

citations.documentTitle: SOP-COORD-01: Humanitarian Country Team, Clusters, 3W and the Gap List
citations.quote: The 3W records which organization does which activity where. HRI's entries use the cluster's common template: | Field | Example | |---|---| | Organization | Harbourlight Relief International | | Clust

citations.documentTitle: HRI Mozambique: Staff Safety and Security Plan (decision-level summary)
citations.quote: This plan sets out how HRI's Mozambique office makes decisions about staff safety in a disaster response. It describes who decides and what is shared; it does not contain tactical procedures. HRI foll
